A '''shakudo dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper axe]] or [[copper dolabra]] with [[shakudo alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]]. It is a pickaxe and axe with [[Silk Touch]], but without the axe's life steal.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]]; without one, the same copper axe and alloy make a [[shakudo axe]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed {{Value|Shakudo Dolabra|miningspeed}} and has {{Value|Shakudo Dolabra|durability}} durability. Unlike the shakudo pickaxe it has no obsidian rule, so it harvests obsidian too.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Its [[Silk Touch]] intrinsic makes blocks drop themselves. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Shakudo Dolabra|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Shakudo Dolabra|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[shakudo alloy]], which lets the alloy be reused on a fresh copper item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_dolabra.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Notes ==
* Shakudo tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive (2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper instead of 3 gold and 6 copper ingots). A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Dolabras began to shift from weapon hybrids to pure axe and pickaxe tools; the release notes say their damage and weapon intrinsics will be reduced over time.}}
}}
